information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2ODgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ff987110662e1a148daa8e53351f298056fa4fb7/ohc26-logo-full(1).png) Although separate from the Ohio Championship, [Ohio State Summer Mini 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateSummerMini2026) will be hosted on Sunday in the same room as this competition, so consider signing up! Only competitors from Ohio are eligible for the title of Ohio Champion. See [Ohio Champion Title Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioQuietChampionship2026#71561-ohio-champion-title-eligibility) for details. **Note: This competition will only include quiet events and is not recommended for new competitors.** If you are new to competing, please consider registering for the [Ohio Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioChampionship2026) instead. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTI2ODYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b817b515076540d1ba939bef41ed05df1b4428d0/MCA-Final-Logo%20(Vector%20png).avif)
